descriptor: Seasonal recipes for slow home cooking

voice.summary: Larder & Ladle writes like a kind aunt reading a recipe aloud at the stove. It is warm, specific about heat and time, and fond of cupboard staples and long evenings.
dos: Give quantities in both metric and US cups
Describe doneness by sight and smell
Say how long and how hot, exactly
donts: Do not call a dish 'easy' without saying why

taglines: Recipes you can cook in slippers
boilerplate: Larder & Ladle publishes seasonal recipes for slow home cooking, with scalable quantities, metric and US measures, and a step-by-step cook mode.

microcopy.success: Timer set for 40 minutes. We will tell you when to check.
microcopy.error: That timer would not start. Use your own clock for now.
microcopy.empty: No ingredients ticked yet. Tap one as you add it.

logo.note: A small flame is the low oven and the slow simmer.
